nodes.label: IAM plus ownership
nodes.rationale: Backend IAM authorizes actions and ownership limits records; is_staff only controls the frontend admin shell.

nodes.label: Module error codes
nodes.rationale: Stable module owned error codes are translated by both Vietnamese and English frontend messages.

nodes.label: Repository audit recording
nodes.rationale: Writes are centralized in the repository so audit and journal events share the business transaction.

nodes.label: Explicit repository audit
nodes.rationale: Repository audit avoids hidden save side effects and extra permission lookups.

nodes.label: Independent IAM RBAC
nodes.rationale: One role and permission source avoids disagreement with Django user_permissions.

nodes.label: Request scoped context
nodes.rationale: A ContextVar must reset in finally to avoid user leakage when a worker thread is reused.

nodes.label: CLI generated shadcn primitives
nodes.rationale: Regenerate primitives with the CLI and retain focus styling instead of copying edited reference components.

nodes.label: Stable API error contract
nodes.rationale: One exception handler and stable error codes replace duplicated response wrappers.

nodes.label: Single origin Next.js to Django proxy
nodes.norm_label: single origin next.js to django proxy
nodes.rationale: Browser requests use one origin, allowing host only cookies and avoiding cross domain cookie reliance.

nodes.label: Frontend dependency direction
nodes.rationale: Foundation modules stay independent of feature modules to prevent cyclic imports.

nodes.label: Frontend module registry checks
nodes.rationale: A registration test catches missing routes, translations and navigation entries.

nodes.label: Branch Workflow
nodes.community_name: Giám sát lỗi với Sentry (Error Tracking & Performance)

nodes.label: Declarative module base
nodes.rationale: Common behavior belongs in shared bases; modules declare exceptions and options instead of duplicating logic.

nodes.label: Default deny permissions
nodes.rationale: Undeclared actions return 403 so a new endpoint is not exposed accidentally.

nodes.label: List query count guard
nodes.rationale: Compare one item with many items to catch N+1 serializer or repository queries.

nodes.label: Soft delete visibility
nodes.rationale: Reads and row locks exclude deleted records, preventing updates to deleted resources.
